name: vehicle-knowledge-platform
description: Operations entrypoint for the Vehicle Knowledge Platform (VKP). Used to run localhost containers and microservices. Not an application package.

scripts.localhost:services:start-all: npm run localhost:services:java:start-all && npm run localhost:services:python:start-all
scripts.localhost:services:stop-all: npm run localhost:services:java:stop-all && npm run localhost:services:python:stop-all
scripts.localhost:services:status-all: npm run localhost:services:java:status-all && npm run localhost:services:python:status-all
scripts.localhost:services:restart-all: npm run localhost:services:stop-all && npm run localhost:services:start-all
scripts.localhost:portals:install-all: npm run localhost:portals:admin:install && npm run localhost:portals:search:install
scripts.localhost:portals:restart-all: npm run localhost:portals:stop-all && npm run localhost:portals:start-all
scripts.localhost:start-all: npm run localhost:containers:start-all && npm run localhost:services:start-all && npm run localhost:portals:start-all
scripts.localhost:stop-all: npm run localhost:portals:stop-all && npm run localhost:services:stop-all && npm run localhost:containers:stop-all
scripts.localhost:status-all: npm run localhost:containers:status-all && npm run localhost:services:status-all && npm run localhost:portals:status-all
scripts.localhost:restart-all: npm run localhost:portals:stop-all && npm run localhost:services:stop-all && npm run localhost:services:start-all && npm run localhost:portals:start-all
